promotion_history.reason: Migrated existing best_model.pkl as the first registry version.
First version promoted (no prior baseline to compare against)

FORCED past the gate deliberately (Round 10). Justification: (1) the gate compared incomparable inputs — live stored metrics were measured on the OLD pre-correction test set (support=953 fails) vs the candidate on the corrected set (support=972), so its -5.65pp recall delta is not a real comparison. (2) On the SAME corrected test set at the same 0.50 threshold the candidate wins precision 0.7931 vs 0.7326 (+6.05pp), F1 0.7869 vs 0.7752, PR-AUC 0.8808 vs 0.8770; it trails only on recall. (3) At MATCHED recall it dominates: R=0.8241/P=0.7362 vs frozen R=0.8230/P=0.7326. (4) Round 9 established the frozen model recall was inflated by one-directional label noise (428 Fail->Pass corrections) it had been TRAINED on. (5) Best PR-AUC of all four candidates. Honest validation-derived threshold is 0.475, within the project 0.03 noise band of the deployed 0.50, so FAIL_THRESHOLD was deliberately left unchanged.
